# AI Video Creation for Beginners: From Script to Final Cut in 30 Minutes Creating videos used to feel so intimidating, didn't it? 💕 Expensive equipment, complex software, hours of editing... it all felt overwhelming. But today, I want to show you how AI makes video creation easy and accessible for everyone. You'll go from script to final cut in just 30 minutes! Let's begin. --- ## Step 1: Write Your Script with [[link:/tools/23|[[link:/tools/23|Rytr]]]] ✍️ First, let's create your video script with [[link:/tools/23|Rytr]] — it's so easy! 💖 [[link:/tools/23|Rytr]] has templates for YouTube videos, social media, explainer videos, and more. Just pick a template, tell it what your video is about, and let [[link:/tools/23|Rytr]] write your script! See our [[link:/tools/23|[[link:/tools/23|Rytr]] tool page]] for examples. ### [[link:/tools/23|Rytr]] Tips ✨ - Pick the "YouTube Video" template for long-form content - Use "Social Media Post" for short-form videos - Ask [[link:/tools/23|Rytr]] to include visual suggestions in your script **🔗 Try [[link:/tools/23|Rytr]] Free**: {{AFFILIATE_RYTR}} --- ## Step 2: Create Your Video with [[link:/tools/78|Pictory]] 🎬 Now for the magic part — turning your script into a video with [[link:/tools/201|Pictory]]! 🌟 [[link:/tools/201|Pictory]] takes your text and automatically creates a video with scenes, images, and AI voiceover. It's like having a video production team in your browser — so gentle and easy to use. Check out our [[link:/tools/78|[[link:/tools/201|Pictory]] tool page]] for examples! ### [[link:/tools/201|Pictory]] Tips 💫 - Paste your script and let [[link:/tools/201|Pictory]] suggest scenes - Pick the AI voice that sounds best to you - Use templates for a professional look **🔗 Try [[link:/tools/201|Pictory]] Free**: {{AFFILIATE_PICTORY}} --- ## Step 3: Polish Your Video with [[link:/tools/51|VEED]] ✨ Once you have your video, use [[link:/tools/51|VEED]] to add the finishing touches! 🎨 [[link:/tools/51|VEED]] makes it easy to add captions, trim scenes, adjust colors, and more. The interface is so intuitive — you'll feel like a pro in no time. See our [[link:/tools/51|[[link:/tools/51|VEED]] tool page]] for more details! ### [[link:/tools/51|VEED]] Tips ✨ - Add auto captions for better reach and accessibility - Use the trim tool to remove any awkward pauses - Add background music from [[link:/tools/51|VEED]]'s library **🔗 Try [[link:/tools/51|VEED]] Free**: {{AFFILIATE_VEED}} --- ## Ready to Create Your First Video? 💫 See? Creating professional videos doesn't have to be scary or expensive.
